component.name: FileMCP
component.summary: Share a local workspace with ChatGPT through MCP

description.p: FileMCP gives ChatGPT controlled access to one local workspace through the Model Context Protocol. It can read and modify files, run Git operations and, only when explicitly enabled, run shell commands.
The MCP server listens only on the loopback interface and is reached through the OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel. The runtime API key is stored in the Secret Service keyring, never in the settings file.
